nodes.description: Saccharomyces cerevisiae ALG6 expressed through an Sf9/baculovirus system was purified for cryo-EM and synthetic-substrate assays. The apo nanodisc structure is 3.0 Å and donor-bound detergent structure 3.9 Å. Patient positions were mapped onto the yeast structure; they were not functionally tested as a clinical allele series. The acceptor groove, donor-glucose geometry and binding order remain incompletely resolved.
